title: Lesson: Listening: Implication, Irony and Accents
description: Practice Listening: Implication, Irony and Accents.

questions.question: Practice Listening: Implication, Irony and Accents.
questions.explanation: Practice Listening: Implication, Irony and Accents.

questions.question: A says "How was the trip?" B says "Oh, it went brilliantly. The train was cancelled twice." What does B imply?
questions.explanation: The facts contradict "brilliantly", so B is being ironic: the trip went badly.

questions.question: What is "It's getting rather warm in here" often used to imply?
questions.explanation: It is an indirect request to make the room cooler.
answers: A request to open a window or lower the heat

questions.question: What does "Not the brightest idea" usually mean?
questions.explanation: It is an understatement meaning a very bad idea.
